info.title: SWD School API
info.description: Go implementation of the backend assignment. No authentication is specified. Lists use limit/offset. Teachers belong to schools through classroom assignments. School/classroom deletes are restricted while referenced. PUT replaces all writable fields. Unknown JSON fields and query parameters are rejected. One MiB request body limit. Input IDs are accepted but ignored, the resource URL or database determines IDs.

put.description: Full replacement of writable fields. Teacher classroom_ids defaults to an empty list when omitted. Resource ID comes from the URL.
